texts.notes: Mommsen orders witnesses by six 'classes' defined by the book ranges they carry, all from one archetype; only for I-IV,39 are two orders coordinate (class 1 MONX[+Z, EF] vs class 2 LRK+PD), which is the recorded top. Later parts: class 3 TU (VI-VIII,10), class 4 BZK+Halle fragment (VII,42-XII, perhaps once one codex with class 2), class 5 epitome (I vs HG), class 6 EFC (Q archetype, class 1 in I-IV,39 then supplemented from a K-like class-2 book). Many deteriores are contaminated; EF interpolated.

texts.notes: Two families from a common archetype: Teatina A with BFT (BFT thought to derive from the Teatine corpus, not necessarily from A itself) vs Dionysiana aucta EC (C not copied from E). Third order HGDM (Dionysio-Hadriana) drew on both families, so it is contaminated across the top division. Excerpts KV (synod 502 only) come from outside the common archetype. Siglum C appears as '0' in the OCR siglum list.
